fact: 1917年4月16日至5月9日的尼维尔攻势以贵妇小径（Chemin des Dames）为主攻方向。法军主帅尼维尔此前承诺48小时内突破德军防线、伤亡约1万人；实际首日即遭德军纵深阵地与机枪火力压制，4月25日主攻势被暂停。战役结束时法军伤亡约18.7万人，德军约16.3万人，战线几乎未动。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Nivelle offensive
sources.quote: The Nivelle offensive (16 April – 9 May 1917) was a Franco-British operation on the Western Front in the First World War that led to mutinies in the French Army. ... the main French offensive on the Aisne began on 16 April and also achieved considerable tactical success but the attempt to force a strategically decisive battle on the Germans was a costly failure and by 25 April the main offensive had been suspended. ... Casualties and losses French : 187,000; Russian : 5,183; 32 tanks c. 163,000

sources.title: Wikipedia, Chemin des Dames
sources.quote: The final count, when the offensive was over, was 187,000 French casualties and 163,000 Germans casualties. The German defenders suffered much less, but lost some 20,000 prisoners, 40 cannons, and 200 machine guns. The high French casualty count, in so few days and with such minimal gains, was perceived at headquarters and by the French public as a disaster.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Nivelle offensive
sources.quote: The French part of the offensive was intended to be decisive by breaking through the German defences on the Aisne front within 48 hours, with casualties expected to be around 10,000 men.

fact: 1917年4月17日至6月30日，法军爆发大规模兵变：超过3.5万名士兵卷入，112个师中有68个师受影响，但受处罚者不足3000人。经军事法庭审判，有记录的死刑判决629例、实际执行49例，另有2878人被判苦役。兵变者主要诉求是停止无谓的步兵冲锋、增加休假与改善伙食，而非政治革命；事件在当时被严格保密。

sources.title: Wikipedia, French Army in World War I（引 Guy Pedroncini 统计）
sources.quote: Over 35,000 soldiers were involved with 68 out of 112 divisions affected, but fewer than 3,000 men were punished. Following a series of courts-martial, there were 49 documented executions and 2,878 sentences to penal servitude with hard labour. ... The mutinies started on 17 April and ended on 30 June 1917.

fact: 1917年5月，尼维尔被解除总司令职务，由贝当接任。贝当没有采用集体惩罚，而是以轮换休整、增加回家休假、改善伙食与医疗外科条件来恢复士气；到1917年夏，法军秩序基本恢复，并在8月于默兹河左岸的凡尔登取得一次有限胜利。法军此后转入防御，等待美军到达。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Chemin des Dames
sources.quote: General Philippe Pétain, who had opposed this offensive, was called in to take over from Nivelle and to re-establish order. This he did without harsh collective punishments. ... Conversely, Pétain instituted positive changes, such as longer home leaves and better food and medical/surgical assistance for the troops. By the Summer of 1917, order had returned to the French army

sources.title: Wikipedia, Nivelle offensive
sources.quote: The failure of the Nivelle strategy and the high number of French casualties led to mutinies, the dismissal of Nivelle, his replacement by Philippe Pétain and the adoption of a defensive strategy by the French, while their armies recuperated and rearmed.

fact: 1917年2月25日，巴黎进一步收紧面包管制：全市只允许销售一种面包，重700克、长80厘米，须在出炉24小时后才能出售；特殊面包与奶油糕点被禁止。1917年法国设立粮食供应部，同年开始发放个人食品供应卡；1918年才改为按消费票券配给。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Paris in World War I
sources.quote: Restrictions were tightened even further on February 25, 1917, with the requirement that only a single type of loaf of bread could be sold; it weighed seven hundred grams, was eighty centimeters long, and was sold twenty-four hours after it was baked. Special breads and brioches were forbidden.

sources.title: 1914-1918 Online, Food and Nutrition (France)
sources.quote: In 1917, its transformation into a Ministry of the General Provisioning, then the Provisioning and the Agriculture, illustrated the planned economy set up regarding food and provisioning during the war. From then on, the state ... established individual cards of food supply in 1917 and consumption tickets in 1918. ... the late introduction of the sugar and bread ration cards (1917-1918) shows how the shortage was more efficiently controlled than in Germany or Austria.

fact: 1917年12月1日、5日与19日的法令建立起法国全国面包配给制度：消费者按年龄、劳动强度与收入分为三类，重体力且低收入者中成年男性每日600克、成年女性500克；轻体力劳动者男性400克、女性300克；其余人每日200克。供应凭政府经地方当局发放的个人卡，随卡发放面额100克的票券；出借或出售配给卡一律没收，伪造或使用假卡、假票者将被起诉；面包店、餐馆、旅馆无票供应面包被禁止。

sources.title: Monthly Labor Review（美国劳工统计局）, February 1918, Vol. VI, No. 2: Bread Rationing in France（译自 La République Française, Dec. 1, 5, 19, 1917）
sources.quote: Bread consumers are divided into three classes as determined by age, social condition, etc. ... 1. Those performing heavy manual labor, and having a small income: Men over 16 years of age 600 grams ... 2. Those doing light work, and having a small income: Men over 16 years of age 400 grams ... 3. All persons not included in above classes 200 grams. Supplies are delivered upon presentation of authorized cards ... Loaned or sold cards are confiscated. ... Makers or users of false books or tickets are subject to prosecution. Delivery of bread by bakers, restaurant, hotel, or boarding-house keepers otherwise than in exchange for tickets is prohibited.

fact: 1917年巴黎的配给与燃料短缺同时挤压家庭预算：市政委员会向贫困家庭提供每人每日135克马铃薯的配给；市政府为老人、失业者与应征士兵家属保留煤炭，每40天可购50公斤一袋，价格4.75法郎。1916至1917年严冬气温降至零下7摄氏度，煤炭短缺使发电受限，电车有时因缺电停驶。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Paris in World War I
sources.quote: Other food staples were also rationed; the municipal council provided a ration of 135 grams of potatoes per day per person to poor families. ... the municipality reserved supplies of coal for the elderly, the unemployed, and the families of mobilized soldiers; they were permitted a fifty kilogram sack of coal every forty days for a payment of 4.75 francs. Shortages of coal also limited the generation of electricity, and sometimes the tram lines could not operate for lack of power.

fact: 1915年4月至1917年4月，法国贸易逆差累计达270亿法郎，主要靠英美军援与出售海外证券弥补。1917年3月31日，法郎对美元比平价低约11%，对瑞士法郎低13.5%，对西班牙比塞塔与瑞典克朗低21%。1917年4月美国参战后，法郎被逐步钉在约5.70法郎兑1美元；战前平价约为5.18。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica 1926, Supplement Volume 2, p.131（Wikisource 全文）
sources.quote: Between April 1915 and April 1917 the total deficit of the French balance of trade rose to 27,000 million francs. ... On March 31 1917 the franc was 11% below par in relation to the dollar, 13·5% in relation to the Swiss franc, and 21% in relation to the peseta and the Swedish krone.

sources.title: Pierre-Cyrille Hautcoeur, Was the Great War a watershed? The economics of World War I in France
sources.quote: The franc/dollar exchange rate remained below 6 until the end of the war, being pegged successively at 5.83 from July 1916, 5.7 from the US entry into the war, and even 5.45 in the last quarter of 1918.

fact: 法国战时财政的主渠道不是长期公债，而是1914年9月13日法令设立的「国防券」（Bons de la Défense Nationale）：一年、六个月、三个月乃至一个月的短期国库券，按面值兑付，可在到期前三个月内向法兰西银行贴现，也可像支票一样划线转让，实际上相当于可随时动用的国库存款。为抑制浮动债务膨胀，财政部又发行10年、6年、5年期的国防债券；1917年发行的是4%长期公债，实际收益率约5.83%。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica 1926, Supplement Volume 2, p.131（Wikisource 全文）
sources.quote: The principal medium for the transfer of funds to the Govt. for War purposes was the National Defence Bills devised by M. Ribot and issued in virtue of the decree of Sept. 13 1914. These bills were Treasury securities with a currency of one year, six months, three months and even one month after April 1918. They were repayable at par, and could be discounted at the Bank of France within three months of maturity. ... the state decided to issue a series of irredeemable loans—the 5% loan of 1915 (real rate 5·73%); the 5% loan of 1916 (real rate 5·71%); the 4% loan of 1917 (real rate 5·83%)

fact: 雷诺FT轻型坦克于1917年投产，是世界上第一种把武器装在可全向旋转炮塔内的量产坦克；其「前部乘员舱、后部发动机、顶部旋转炮塔」的布局此后成为坦克的标准构型。法军订购约3500辆，法国最终生产超过3000辆，但绝大部分在1918年完成。该车重约6.5吨，双人乘员，时速约7公里。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Renault FT
sources.quote: The Renault FT (frequently referred to in post-World War I literature as the FT-17, FT17, or similar) is a French light tank ... The FT was the first production tank to have its armament within a fully rotating turret. ... The Renault FT's configuration (crew compartment at the front, engine compartment at the back, and main armament in a revolving turret) became and remains the standard tank layout. ... Produced 1917–1919 ... Over 3,000 Renault FT tanks were manufactured by France, most of them in 1918.

sources.title: MilitaryHistoryNow, The Renault FT — Meet the Tiny French Tank That Revolutionized Armoured Warfare
sources.quote: By 1917, the first prototype of the automitrailleuse à chenilles Renault FT modèle 1917 was complete. Also known simply as the char d'assaut (assault tank), the French military ordered 3,500 models.
